clues: This town lies on the east coast of its province in China, by a wide sea. Other big towns lie to its north, west, and south.
Strong monsoon winds shape the rain here through the year. Most of the rain falls in just three months, from June through August.
The town in its form today was founded in January of 1983. Before that, it had long been just a small county town.
This town runs the largest area of any town in its whole province. Its land stretches far wider than all the towns around it.
Sea salt has been made in the fields around this town for a very long time. Salt work here began in the year 119 BC.
